description: Caravaggio — Colore: Ebony & white Codice: 5659 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Damask Scala: Large Altezza: 140.5 cm Rapporto: 64 cm × 94 cm Toni: Black The late-16th-century Italian painter CARAVAGGIO’s dramatic and affecting brushwork and scenery ushered in the Baroque style in Europe.
